summary: An enum union for values that may be present or absent.

types.name: enum union opt<T>
types.description: An enum union representing either no value or a value of type T.

functions.name: try
functions.signature: comptime expr T opt::try<T>(expr opt<T> self)
functions.description: Produces staged code that unwraps an optional or returns none.

functions.name: try_or
functions.signature: comptime expr T opt::try_or<T>(expr opt<T> self, expr void on_none)
functions.description: Produces staged code that runs a fallback when an optional is none.

functions.name: unwrap_or_else
functions.signature: comptime expr T opt::unwrap_or_else<T>(expr opt<T> self, expr unreachable on_none)
functions.description: Produces staged code that uses an unreachable fallback when an optional is none.

functions.name: is_some
functions.description: Checks whether an optional contains a value.
functions.returnDescription: True when the value is present.

functions.name: is_none
functions.description: Checks whether an optional is empty.
functions.returnDescription: True when no value is present.

functions.name: map
functions.description: Transforms a present optional value with a callback.

functions.name: unwrap_or
functions.description: Returns the contained value or a fallback value.

functions.name: unwrap
functions.description: Returns the contained value or terminates the process.
